meta.title: Date Calculator - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Add or subtract days, months, or years from any date. Get the exact resulting date instantly.
dateCalcHint: Fill in any combination of units — all are applied simultaneously:
steps_date-calculator_1Desc: Pick a base date using the date picker. Use today's date or any past/future date as your starting point for the calculation.
steps_date-calculator_2Desc: Enter the number of days, weeks, months, or years to add or subtract. Choose the operation and the time unit from the controls.
steps_date-calculator_3Desc: The calculated date displays instantly. Copy the result for project deadlines, delivery estimates, subscription renewals, or event planning.
desc: Add or subtract days, months, or years from any date. Get the exact resulting date instantly.
atLeastOne: Please fill in at least one time unit
